description: This file defines an enum DaysInYearCustomStrategyType that specifies strategies for calculating the number of days in a year, particularly in relation to leap years. It explains different modes such as always considering 366 days or only considering 366 days if the period includes February 29th.

classes.name: DaysInYearCustomStrategyType
classes.description: An enum defining strategies for counting days in a year, factoring leap years and specific periods.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the strategy.

methods.name: getHumanReadableName
methods.description: Returns the human-readable name of the strategy.
